name: Yawara Kaho
source:
Mother of the main character. In herLate thirties. A full-time housewife. She is a calm and beautiful woman with a motherly instinct for family life.

Although she is unaware of it, her voluptuous and plump body is a source of amusement to men in the neighborhood.

She is clumsy in love and has never been with a man other than her husband. Since her husband is not sexually active, she is frustrated with him, although she is not aware of it.
